hub.sub: SEO, ads, social, content, email and web from one delivery partner, so you sell a full-service agency without hiring one.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: White-label digital marketing means one partner delivers the full mix of channels while you sell and report them as your own. MMC covers search, paid media, social, content, email and web under a single scope, so agencies can offer full-service packages without hiring a specialist for each channel.
answer.hl: one partner delivers the full mix of channels
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) delivers digital marketing for agencies and works behind your brand. You own the client relationship; we do the work.

points.title: Full mix
points.text: Search, paid, social, content, email, web.

paras: Some agencies prefer a specialist per channel. Others want one partner who joins the dots. Both work; the right choice depends on how many clients you serve and how much coordination you want to manage.

stages.breaks: Buying each channel from a different vendor.
stages.why: Channels do not talk, the client gets six voices, and you coordinate all of them for free.
stages.does: One partner covers the channels in scope under a single plan, so the work fits together.

stages.breaks: Leaving no one in charge of the whole account.
stages.why: When something spans channels, nobody owns it, and the client asks you why.
stages.does: A named lead on our side runs the account day to day and speaks to you, never past you.

stages.breaks: Sending a separate report per channel.
stages.why: Your client reads five reports, finds two contradictions and loses trust in all of them.
stages.does: One combined report from your address, with one view of what worked and one list of next steps.

stages.why: A free social post here and an extra landing page there erase the margin on a retainer.
stages.does: Scope is written per channel, change requests are logged, and anything extra is quoted before work starts.

stages.why: Calls, chasing and rework are time you did not price, and they grow with every channel.
stages.does: A single process and a single point of contact reduce coordination, so the margin you priced stays yours.
